dark_below.description: the room needs light below this many lux, read from its motion things' own illuminance (0.17) — binary_sensor.<room>_dark; without it the sun decides

off_after.description: motion: how long the room stays occupied after this sensor clears (HH:MM:SS, 00:05:00) — the room's hold is the longest of its sensors'

dim.description: light: dimmable (the card shows a slider)
